import urllib.request
import json

# Query NCBI Gene 27134
url = "https://eutils.ncbi.nlm.nih.gov/entrez/eutils/esummary.fcgi?db=gene&id=27134&retmode=json"
req = urllib.request.Request(url, headers={'User-Agent': 'Python/urllib'})
with urllib.request.urlopen(req) as resp:
    gene_data = json.loads(resp.read().decode())

print("NCBI Gene 27134:", gene_data['result']['27134']['name'], gene_data['result']['27134']['description'])
print("Other aliases:", gene_data['result']['27134'].get('otheraliases'))
